regime_context: The China A-shares detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the highest-momentum theme, but leadership is narrow (low breadth, mixed trend health) and the absolute-trend gate has historically not cut drawdowns here. Momentum rank serves as an attention lens, not a return forecast. The market backdrop features heightened geo/macro headlines. Any directional lean is experimental and low-conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch for the challenger, Industrial Metals, to overtake AI Compute & Optics in rank. If confirmed, it would signal a handoff to a high-breadth trending theme. Condition to retire this watch: Industrial Metals' momentum score exceeds AI Compute & Optics' score for 5 consecutive days.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals displays a durable, trending theme (durability 0.69, hurst ‘trend’, breadth 0.538) and is not crowded. While momentum rank lacks forward edge, trend persistence may offer a modest follow-through dynamic. The lean is conditional on the theme maintaining its high rank and trend health; the poor gate history demands caution.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank has no alpha on this market; the trend gate did not protect drawdowns, meaning mean-reversion could abruptly reverse the trend. A macro shock could derail commodity-sensitive themes.

falsifier.text: Industrial Metals drops out of the top 5 in the narrative-rotation rank.
